profile.headline: Software Engineer - responsive web apps
profile.summary:
Responsive web app development
UI / UX design & development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Usability · REST APIs · Java · Visual Standards · React.js · User Experience (UX) · JavaScript · Visual Design · Communication · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Wireframing

positions.title: Lead UI / UX Engineer
positions.description:
HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery, jQuery UI
Develop HTML mockups & JS interactions
Integrate UI mockups into the Team Express template system
Work with UI designers & Java API developers to integrate services into the Custom Express app
Implement customization store enhancements for Custom Express
Interface with all levels of business managers to review requirements

positions.title: Sr UI Engineer
positions.description:
jQuery, jQuery Mobile, Backbone, Underscore, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, LESS, custom tags, JSP, JPA & Java
Led desktop, mobile & tablet web app UI development for eBook reader & admin apps
Worked with Java & backend developers to integrate view & controller code

positions.title: Sr UI Engineer
positions.description:
HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, jQuery Mobile, AJAX, JSON, JSTL, custom tags, JSP, Spring & Java
Led desktop & mobile web app UI development for prepaid debit card account center flows & layouts
Interfaced with web designer to match client branding guidelines
Worked with Java & backend developers to integrate view & controller code

positions.title: Software Developer / Integrator I
positions.description:
HTML5, CSS3, YUI 2 / 3, AJAX, JSON, Presentation Services, JSP & Java
Led desktop & mobile web app UI development for auto insurance product flows & layouts
Created proof-of-concept prototypes to guide other developers
Interfaced with web designer to match wireframes & mockups
Worked with Java & backend developers to integrate view & controller code

positions.title: UI Engineer II
positions.description:
XHTML, CSS, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, JSTL, JSP & ActionScript 3
Developed desktop web app UI for auto dealership designs, layouts, landing pages & widgets around the existing CMS platform
Interfaced with web designer to match mockups & wireframes
Worked with Java developers to integrate view & controller code

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
XHTML, CSS, YUI 2, AJAX, JSON & JSP
Developed desktop web app UI for auto insurance flows & layouts
Interfaced with web designer to match wireframes & mockups
Worked with Java & backend developers to integrate view & controller code

Worked with 3rd party developers to integrate with existing CMS platform

Managed Google AdWords & online marketing reports

Interfaced with web designer to match wireframes & mockups
Worked with PHP & .NET developers to integrate code & design
